extracted.name: Creamed Spinach
extracted.description: This creamed spinach recipe, made with the frozen chopped variety, milk, butter, Parmesan, garlic, and nutmeg, complements a roast and can be made ahead.
ingredient_lines: 4 (10 ounce) boxes boxes frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry; reserve 1/2 cup liquid
instruction_lines: Combine ½ cup spinach liquid, milk, and garlic in a 1-quart microwave-safe measuring cup or small bowl covered with a saucer; microwave (or heat slowly in a medium saucepan) until very hot and steamy. Let stand until garlic softened, 5 to 10 minutes.

Melt butter in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat; whisk in flour. Add hot milk mixture all at once; whisk until smooth. Stir in spinach; cook until sauce is thick and bubbly and spinach is tender but still green, about 5 minutes. Stir in Parmesan cheese, nutmeg, salt, and black pepper. Serve hot.
